title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 047
review_goal: Differentiate bulb, cactus, and camcorder variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Light bulb outline with a zigzag filament inside and a short screw base
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a bulb with a visible zigzag filament inside the glass.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the empty bulb when the center of the globe should stay blank.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot includes a lightning style filament inside the bulb globe.

items.depicts_observation: Light bulb outline with an empty round globe above a short screw base
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a plain bulb outline with no filament marks inside the globe.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the lit bulb when a zigzag filament should be visible inside.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the bulb globe empty and removes the inner zigzag mark.

items.depicts_observation: Tall cactus with one arm on each side above a flat ground line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a tall desert cactus with two side arms on a ground line.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the oval thorn cactus when the plant should not be enclosed by an outer ring.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is a classic tall cactus silhouette with two side arms and a base line.

items.depicts_observation: Oval cactus ring with side thorns and one centered tall leaf
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a rounded cactus form with an outer ring and thorn marks.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the tall desert cactus when separate side arms on a ground line should be visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot wraps the cactus around one center leaf and thorn marks in an oval form.

items.depicts_observation: Tilted video camera body with one side handle and one lower hanging cord
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a tilted handheld camcorder body with a visible cord loop.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the lens ring icon when the shape should stay circular instead of camera shaped.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows an angled camera body, a side grip, and a short cord hanging down.
